_comment: Third-party runtime pieces `mcb setup` fetches from their original public sources, each checked against a pinned SHA-256. Pins and sources follow BedrockOnLinux (bol/config.py, bol/vkd3d.py). None of these are redistributed by this repo.

xgameruntime_threading.what: Microsoft's native XGameRuntime, loaded by WineGDK's xgameruntime.dll as xgameruntime.dll.threading

openssl_xcurl_set.what: OpenSSL libcurl + DLL closure + CA-injecting XCurl shim + cryptbase RNG stub (BedrockOnLinux's reproducible build)

gdk_deps.what: Open-source builds of libHttpClient.GDK.dll and XCurl.dll (minecraft-linux/mcpelauncher-gdk-dependencies)

cacert.what: Mozilla CA bundle (curl.se), refreshed on each setup
